cards.title: France Requests International Arrest Warrants for Three Iranian Cyberattack Suspects

points.text: French and European outlets such as France 24 and RFI provide extensive operational details regarding the specific supermarket chains affected and the technical methods used in the refrigeration hack, whereas Middle Eastern outlets focus primarily on Tehran's diplomatic denials.
points.message: summary states 24, which appears in none of the source articles: source it or cut it
